messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Ibuprofen works by reducing hormones that cause inflammation and pain in the body.
Ibuprofen is used to reduce fever.
Ibuprofen is used to treat pain or inflammation.
The pain or inflammation is caused by many conditions.
These conditions include headache, toothache, back pain, arthritis, menstrual cramps, or minor injury.
Ibuprofen is used in adults and children.
Some formulations are also used in premature babies to close a certain heart defect.

The relation 'caused by' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition or symptom is caused by the object condition or factor.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has symptom': The condition specified by the subject entity is associated with the symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'is different from': The subject condition or effect is distinct or different from the object condition or effect.
C. 'has severity': The medical condition or effect specified by the subject has the severity specified by the object entity.
D. 'can lead to': The subject condition or event may result in the medical complication or outcome specified by the object entity.
E. 'occur regardless of': The medical event or condition specified by the subject entity can happen irrespective of the presence or absence of the factor specified by the object entity.
